visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing an oversized white button-down shirt and loose-fitting denim jeans stands on a white digital weight scale in the center of a domestic kitchen area. In the background, a grey refrigerator, various kitchen containers on shelves, and a Cube guitar amplifier are visible under bright indoor lighting. Large white Chinese and Japanese text overlays the bottom half of the frame as he steps off the scale. (2) The same man stands in the kitchen, now holding a grey ceramic mug and a translucent plastic cup, gesturing with his free hand while looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. A white line-art icon of an umbrella appears in the center of the frame, followed by three colorful umbrella icons (yellow, red, blue) that slide into view. (3) The scene cuts to a different man in a white t-shirt and silver chain necklace standing in front of a colorful wall mural depicting a person at a food stall. Animated stickers of girls with pink hair rollers and a thinking emoji appear around his head as he mimics the action of putting in rollers with his hands. (4) Transition to an outdoor urban alleyway where a third man in a black t-shirt and a small black crossbody bag smiles and gestures with both hands. A graphic showing three people sitting on a bench (a child, an adult, and an elderly person) appears at the bottom. The background shows city buildings and parked cars under flat natural daylight. (5) A fourth man with longer brown hair and a black baseball cap stands in front of the mural, wearing a white t-shirt. An animation of a boy drinking from a water bottle with a red 'X' mark appears next to him as he gestures toward it. (6) A fifth man in a white t-shirt with a silver chain necklace holds two black dumbbells in a gym or home setting with a white curtain. He points his finger upward and then a graphic of a storefront with the text 'Mama's Shaved Ice' in Chinese characters appears. (7) Back to the first man in the kitchen, he is now in a white-tiled bathroom or utility room holding a black hair flat iron. He gestures with his hands near a sink, and graphics of a red drink cup and white tissue packets appear on screen to illustrate his point.
